cases.why_gold: Lea has no 39105. History is enough. Naming Sam again (he just returned the offer) or Priya from print skills fails.

must_draft.unfilled: nobody here has dutch cooperative law

cases.why_gold: Who-is-needed: dutch-cooperative-law is nobody. A DRI card that names the gap is useful; inventing a lawyer is not. DriDraft.suggested is required on the wire — gold at intent level is null plus unfilled until the schema names that case.
